inputs.proposal: J2534 request modes: the set scheduler owns requests whenever the profile has mux defs, ?poll= is rejected at parse time unless ?filter= gives it a channel, and the single-PID poll request is built on the first channel.
inputs.original_proposal: J2534 request modes: the set scheduler owns requests whenever the profile has mux defs, ?poll= is rejected at parse time unless ?filter= gives it a channel, and the single-PID poll request is built on the first channel.

blockers: claim: Hardcoded channel index t->chans[0] in build_mode01_request creates a critical bug - the original code correctly resolved the channel index for the PID, but the new code uses the first channel unconditionally. This can cause incorrect PID requests to be sent on the wrong CAN channel, breaking protocol compliance when poll_pid requires a different channel than the first one.; file: core/src/j2534_transport.cpp; quote: build_mode01_request(req, t->chans[0].tx_id, t->poll_pid);
questions: What is the lifecycle of t->chans array? Is it guaranteed to be non-empty when build_mode01_request is called with a poll_pid?
If poll_pid is set and the profile declares no channels, should this be an error at parse time or at attach time when channels can be resolved?
What is the relationship between t->chans and t->chan_count? Does chan_count account for all valid channels including profile defaults?

claim: sched_mode logic change removes the poll_pid check: the original code had 'const bool sched_mode = (t->poll_pid == 0) && (t->sched.count > 0);' which correctly prevented scheduler mode when poll_pid is set. The new 'const bool sched_mode = (t->sched.count > 0);' ignores poll_pid entirely, so the scheduler could be built even when single-PID polling is requested, violating the J2534 request mode semantics.; file: core/src/j2534_transport.cpp; quote: const bool sched_mode = (t->sched.count > 0);
nits: The comment update in j2534_worker about 'scheduler owns requests whenever the profile has mux defs' contradicts the actual change where sched_mode no longer checks poll_pid
The example URI in SettingsPage.qml now shows the poll parameter but the code change rejects poll without filter, creating a documentation/code mismatch
The variable naming 'sched_mode' is now misleading since it doesn't consider poll_pid - consider renaming to 'has_scheduler' or similar
